hero.sub: On a narrow Lincoln Park lot, the sewer line runs under the stoop, the front garden and the sidewalk. Trenchless repair rebuilds the pipe through small openings, so most of that stays where it is. Our office is on Diversey Parkway.

blocks.body: Trenchless sewer repair, also called no-dig sewer repair, fixes a damaged pipe without digging a trench along its full length. Instead of opening up your yard from the house to the street, we work through one or two access points and repair the pipe from the inside or replace it in place. There are two main methods: cured-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining and pipe bursting. Both fix the line underground, so what's above it stays untouched.

blocks.body: Many Lincoln Park homes sit within a few feet of the building next door, with a narrow gangway and a front garden behind an iron fence. A trench in that space is hard to dig and harder to restore. Trenchless repair needs a small access point at each end of the damaged pipe, so the gangway, the fence and the garden mostly stay as they are. We plan the openings with you before any work starts.

blocks.h2: Trenchless Sewer Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Can a liner go into an old clay lateral?
items.preview: Often, if it still holds its shape.
items.answer: Often. If the clay is cracked but round, it can be lined. Collapsed spots are fixed first.

items.q: Does trenchless work need a city permit?
items.preview: Sewer work in Chicago usually does, and we handle it.
items.answer: Sewer repairs in Chicago usually need a permit. We handle the paperwork for the work we do.

items.q: How long does a liner last?
items.answer: Liners are designed to last for decades.

items.q: Will my building be without plumbing during the work?
items.preview: Usually for part of a day.
items.answer: Usually only for part of the day while the liner cures. We'll schedule it with you.

items.q: Can you line a pipe that runs under the basement floor?
items.answer: Often, from a cleanout inside the basement.

items.q: How much does trenchless sewer repair cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on length, depth and method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on how much of the line needs work, the depth, the method and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
